stem: The duration of its day and tilt of its axis are almost identical to those of the Earth. This is true of :
expl: The duration of the day on Earth is 23 hours, 56 minutes 4 seconds and the tilt of its axis is 230 30'. The planet Mars has nearly the same value as Earth for its day duration which is 24 hours, 37 minutes 25 seconds and Mars tilt of the axis is 250 12'. The duration of the day and tilt of the axis of other planetes is as follows-Uranus – duration of its day – 17 hours 14 minutes Neptune – duration of its day – 16 hours 6 minutes Saturn – duration of its day – 10 hours 34 minutes

stem:
Assertion (A) : To orbit around the Sun the planet Mars takes lesser time than the time taken by the Earth.
Reason (R) : The diameter of the planet Mars is less than that of Earth.
Code :

options.label: a
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true, individually true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

options.label: b
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are individually true ,but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

expl: The time taken by any planet to orbit around the Sun depends on the distance between the Sun and the planet. The distance between the Sun and Mars is 227943824 km (228 million km) , while the Earth is at a distance of 149598262 km (149.6 million km) from the Sun and the orbital period of Earth is 365.256 days and that of Mars is 687.0 days. Thus statement (A) is false. The diameter of Mars is 6792 km while Earth’s equatorial diameter is about 12756 km. Thus Reason (R) is correct.

stem: Which one of the following conditions is most relevant for the presence of life on Mars?

options.label: c
options.text: Occurrence of ice cap and frozen water

expl: In the beginning, Mars was treated equivalent to Earth because of occurrence of ice caps and water ice on Mars. In Mars atmosphere, it has 95.1% carbon dioxide, 2.59% nitrogen, 1.94 % argon, 0.16% oxygen and 210 ppm water etc. Mars polar ice caps and water ice is most relevant for the presence of life on Mars. The average temperature of Mars (– 65ºC) is quite similar to Earth (-850C). Mars rotates on its axis approx. 24.6 hours and revolves around the sun approx. 686.98 days.

stem: Phoenix Mars Lander landed on the surface of Mars on :
expl: Phoenix Mars Lander was launched on 4th August, 2007 and landed on 25 May, 2008 at the North Pole on Mars. On 2 November, 2008 the mission officially ended. Phoenix had given the information about the presence of ice on Mars. Note : Since the exact date is not given in the options the, closest date 26 May, 2008 will be the answer.
